messages.author: b82c68dca2181495
messages.subject: help with inla.hyperpar.sample() function
parts:
Hi all,

I've been trying to use inla.hyperpar.sample() but I keep getting the following error massage:

> inla.hyperpar.sample(10, model_poiRes.GI)
Error: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors


note: My inla.object ('model_poiRes.GI') was created using control.compute=list(config=TRUE) argument.

Any idea why I'm getting this result?

Thank you in advance !
